article.headline: Scores from last Night: Jim Hill falls 70–42 to unbeaten Carter
article.html:
Jim Hill’s boys basketball team lost 70–42 to unbeaten Carter of Dallas on Wednesday, November 25, at the Denton Ryan Showcase. The Jackson school fell to a listed 4–3, while Carter improved to 5–0, leaving the Cowboys unbeaten after the interstate matchup.

The result extended Jim Hill’s losing streak to three games after a winning opening to the season. The Tigers’ current schedule lists victories over Germantown, Natchez, Provine and Starkville before consecutive defeats against Canton, Episcopal School of Dallas and Carter.

Wednesday’s defeat followed Jim Hill’s 61–55 loss to Episcopal School of Dallas on Tuesday, November 24. The Tigers finished behind Dallas opponents on consecutive days, scoring 55 points in the first game and 42 against Carter. The completed Carter matchup report confirms the final, with the Tigers taking their third loss of the season.

Jim Hill’s next listed game is at Lanier on December 1.
